name: Dual Vertex Localization via Mass Point Centering
aliases: Dual Node Localization via Connected Components
definition: An algorithm to approximate the position of a dual vertex d based on the barycentres of the connected components of the implicit function F(x) inside a leaf cell.
summary: Dual Vertex Localization via Mass Point Centering determines dual vertex positions by computing volumetric intersection barycentres, ensuring accurate placement where traditional methods fail.
